purpose: Source-supported provisional native NL training admission and training-only acquisition reservation
new_geographic_groups: Assign genuinely new groups to train; preserve every prior acquisition and named geographic-group role. Reject validation, test, quarantine, prior exposure and previously reserved source identities.
rank: Within each source stream: absolute observation offset, source uncertainty, AIS bracket gap, product UUID, source identity. Vessel stream first; no classifier output or pixels used.

admission.evidence: Every check must cite a hash-bound evidence record. The evaluator verifies receipts and declarations, not their physical truth. Source proximity or source uniqueness alone is insufficient. No probability weights are inferred.
admission.original_masks_and_decisions: Preserve; any future admitted label needs an additive dossier and separately versioned training export. This reservation creates neither labels nor a training export.

limitations: Provisional research criteria, not C-CORE requirements
Source-centred selection and prior project exposure must be disclosed
No independent reviewer; no independently validated accuracy or promotion
Historical IIP and modern AIS may confound era, location and class
No minimum sample count here establishes statistical sufficiency
